description: A Python API on Postgres: migrations, test database and money handling, with a moved test backend and a pool setting that changed.

memories.text: Schema migrations are Alembic revisions under migrations/versions; create one with `alembic revision --autogenerate -m <name>` and review the generated diff by hand.
Never edit a migration that has shipped to production; add a new revision that changes the schema forward.
Do not modify released Alembic migrations - write a new revision instead, since production has already applied the old one.
Money is stored as integer cents in BIGINT columns; never use floats or NUMERIC with implicit rounding for amounts.
The test suite uses an in-memory SQLite database, so no database server is needed to run the tests.
Tests run against Postgres 16 in a container that `make test-db` starts; pytest reads its URL from LEDGER_TEST_DATABASE_URL.
The database connection pool size is hard-coded to 5 in ledger/db.py.
The database connection pool size comes from LEDGER_POOL_SIZE (default 20); ledger/db.py no longer hard-codes it.
Migration 0042 took about 3 minutes on the staging snapshot restored on 2026-08-02.
Ran pytest -k refunds after the change and all 38 selected tests passed.
The staging database is temporarily read-only while the vendor migrates its storage.
HTTP handlers live in ledger/api/<resource>.py and each registers its routes in ledger/api/__init__.py.

queries.query: Add a refund_reason column to the payments table.
Write tests for the new refund endpoint that exercise the database.
Fix rounding errors in invoice totals.

task.question: In which unit and column type does ledger-api store money amounts? Answer in a few words.

queries.query: Tune the database connection pool for the API workers under load.

task.question: Which environment variable sets ledger-api's database connection pool size? Answer with the variable name only.

queries.query: Migration 0031 has a typo in an index name; fix it.
